data.body: CROSS-EPIC DEPENDENCY from 411b-a047-18de-4516: 411b's Phase 5 (SC6) requires the consolidated /dso:onboarding delivered by this epic. Specifically: 411b adds a mutation-testing phase to the consolidated onboarding that detects in-scope stacks (Python, Ruby, JS/TS, Go) via manifest files; surfaces the cost/tradeoff context before per-stack consent; writes mutation.<stack>.enabled keys; copies mutation-testing.yml workflow template. 411b's Phases 1-4 ship independently in informational mode while 136b-6758 is implemented; Phase 5 lands once consolidated onboarding is available.
